title: FEMA Region VI: IT Equipment
description: The Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, has identified a need to replace end-of-life laptops and acquire various IT peripheral equipment necessary to maintain operational capability, cybersecurity compliance, and workforce productivity. The purpose of this Request for Quotation is to solicit quotations from authorized resellers and distributors for the supply of the brand-name equipment identified in the schedule of supplies, including Dell, Cisco, Samsung, Sharp, Crestron, and associated peripheral equipment. This RFQ is issued as an open market total small business set-aside under NAICS 541519, Other Computer Related Services, with a small business size standard of 150 employees. Award will be made to the lowest-priced, technically acceptable responsible small business quoter whose quotation conforms to all requirements of this RFQ. Offerors shall identify the exact brand name, model number, part number, and specifications of each item proposed. All quoted items must match the specified brand name, model number, part number, and configuration exactly. Substitutions, alternatives, or deviations will not be accepted unless expressly authorized in writing by the Contracting Officer. Offerors must be authorized resellers or distributors of the specified brands. The Government reserves the right to verify reseller or distributor authorization directly with the original equipment manufacturer. Offerors shall provide a letter or certificate of authorization upon request. For purposes of this requirement, the prime quoter may satisfy the authorized reseller/distributor requirement by providing documentation demonstrating that the specified products will be procured through an OEM-authorized distributor or reseller channel. The prime quoter is not required to hold direct reseller/distributor authorization from each OEM, provided the documentation submitted is sufficient for the Government to verify the authorized source and channel eligibility of the quoted products. The Government seeks quotes with a total price less than $370,000.00. Quoters should not interpret this figure as a ceiling or as a floor on offers. This information is provided as a courtesy to prospective offerors. The Government may select an offer for award with a price below, at, or exceeding this figure if it finds the quotation technically acceptable, price is reasonable, and funds are available. Delivery shall be FOB Destination. Equipment shall be delivered within 70 calendar days after receipt of order. Shipment tracking information and delivery confirmation shall be provided upon request. All questions and quotations shall be submitted by email to the Contracting Officer, Destiny Dyson, at Destiny.Dyson@fema.dhs.gov. Phone calls will not be accepted. Quoters shall use the Open Market RFQ 70FBR626Q00000044 - FEMA Region VI IT Equipment identifier in all questions, correspondence, and quotation submissions. Questions regarding this RFQ are due no later than September 17, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Central Time. Questions shall be submitted by email to the Contracting Officer, Destiny Dyson, at Destiny.Dyson@fema.dhs.gov. Questions submitted after the deadline may not be answered. Oral questions or responses are not binding. Only written responses issued by the Contracting Officer are binding on the Government. Quotations are due no later than September 23, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Central Time. Quotations shall be submitted by email to the Contracting Officer, Destiny Dyson, at Destiny.Dyson@fema.dhs.gov. Quotations submitted by any other method may not be considered unless expressly authorized by the Contracting Officer. Quoters are responsible for ensuring that quotations are received by the Contracting Officer by the due date and time. Late quotations may not be considered in accordance with applicable procedures. For Dell laptop CLINs, offerors shall quote the exact configurations identified in the applicable attached manufacturer configuration sheets, including the listed hardware specifications and warranty/support packages, unless otherwise expressly authorized in writing by the Contracting Officer. Partial deliveries are permitted, provided all required items are delivered no later than 70 calendar days after receipt of order. Partial delivery does not change the required final delivery date and does not constitute final acceptance of the order unless accepted by the Government. Manufacturer lead-time delays or backorders do not waive the required delivery date unless the Contracting Officer issues a written modification. Quoters should only quote items they reasonably expect to deliver within the required delivery period. Clarification for CLIN 0001 and CLIN 0004: CLIN 0001 and CLIN 0004 require the same Dell Pro Max 16 configuration/specifications. Offerors shall use the Dell Pro Max 16 configuration sheet titled "Dell Pro Max 16 Plus (GIS) - CLIN 0001 and CLIN 0004" for both CLIN 0001 and CLIN 0004. CLIN 0001 quantity is 11 EA. CLIN 0004 quantity is 15 EA. The difference between CLIN 0001 and CLIN 0004 is the quantity and intended use designation only. Quotations shall remain valid for 30 calendar days from the quotation due date.

title: Control System Replacement for Stamford Hurricane Barrier, Stamford, CT
description: Notice of Intent for Stamford Hurricane Barrier � Control Systems Replacement � Rockwell Automation Under the authority of RFO 6.103-1, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers intends to require, on a sole source basis, the purchase and installation of the control system hardware and proprietary programming software to Rockwell Automation for the upcoming Stamford Hurricane Barrier Control System Replacement project. The Stamford Hurricane Barrier is a critical life-safety public infrastructure asset providing immediate flood and storm protection to the region. Specifying Rockwell Automation is essential to the Government's requirement for the following reasons: USACE New England District (NAE) possesses exclusive, in-house engineering expertise in Rockwell Automation platforms. By standardizing Rockwell, NAE�s in-house staff will perform the system programming, installation oversight, and final commissioning at a direct labor cost of $0 to the contract. Procuring a non-Rockwell system would force the Government to procure external, specialized contractor integration services and purchase redundant diagnostic hardware/software and retraining of NAE personnel. The barrier must be activated at a moment's notice during severe weather events. Currently, NAE�s in-house Rockwell experts provide immediate, 24/7 emergency troubleshooting. Utilizing a different platform would render the Government entirely dependent on external contractors for emergency support, introducing an unacceptable delay in emergency response times during critical storm events. Submission of Capabilities: THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT, NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS OR A SOLICITATION. A solicitation will be issued at a later date. However, any firm that believes it can provide an alternative control system platform that meets the technical requirements of the Stamford Hurricane Barrier AND can demonstrate how doing so would not result in a substantial duplication of cost or an unacceptable delay in emergency response for the Government may submit a capability statement. THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. It is a market research tool being used to determine the availability of other qualified sources that can meet the requirements identified above and inherent with the referenced Stamford Hurricane Barrier Control Systems Replacement. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from potential sources because of this notice of intent. All responses received within 15 days of the posting of this notice of intent will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government to require the brand name for the Stamford Hurricane Barrier Control Systems Replacement solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purposes of determining whether to allow alternate system manufacturers. Submit responses within 15 days of the posting of this notice of intent via email to: distephano.marcellus@usace.army.mil (list �W912WJ27BA001 � Stamford Hurricane Barrier Control Systems Replacement� in the subject line of the email).

title: Notice of Intent: MILITARY SATELLITE COMMUNICATIONS (MILSATCOM) SYSTEMS ENGINEERING, INTEGRATION AND TEST(MSEIT)
description: This notice of intent is NOT a request for competitive proposals. The Government intends to negotiate with only one source, LinQuest Corporation, for the continuation of Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (SEIT) support pursuant to RFO 6.103-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. The contemplated action will extend the period of performance of the current CPIF contract for an anticipated 12-months and four 3-month option periods, for a potential total extension of 24 months if all options are exercised. The requirement anticipates a level of effort equivalent to approximately 380 FTEs providing continued SEIT support across the MSEIT mission areas described below. Exercise of any option is subject to the Government's requirements, availability of funds, and applicable contractual and statutory authority. The Government intends to extend the period of performance of the existing CPIF MSEIT contract with LinQuest Corporation to maintain continuity of critical SEIT support while the Government completes its follow-on acquisition activities. The Government has determined that transitioning this interim requirement to another source would result in substantial duplication of cost and/or unacceptable delays in fulfilling the agency's requirements. This determination is subject to consideration of any timely responses received as a result of this notice. The purpose of this acquisition for the Space Systems Command (SSC) Military Communications & Position, Navigation, and Timing (MilComm & PNT) Directorate (SSC/CG) is to provide Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (SEIT) support under the Military Communications SEIT (MSEIT) program. The requirement supports the effectiveness and efficiency of all Military Communications (MilComm or MILSATCOM) systems engineering capabilities, to support the creation and control of system definitions and technical baselines, to support development of end products, and to standardize and streamline engineering processes and products across SSC/CG. The required effort includes relevant expertise and experience with system- of-systems integration of space, mission control, communications planning, cryptographic key management and service user terminal programs, and associated interfaces. Support includes Directorate and program level configuration and data management, architecture management, risk, opportunity, and issue management, requirements management, verification, validation and test, schedule management, cybersecurity, logistics, and sustainment. The contractor will also support communication, collaboration, and integration among Military Communications programs, functional areas, external stakeholders, and interfacing programs. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement which will be considered by the Government. Interested parties must submit sufficient information demonstrating their capability to satisfy the Government's requirements and must identify their business size and socio economic status, as applicable, including (i.e. 8(a), Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HubZone), Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB), or Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), or Large Business). Responses should, at a minimum, address the respondent's relevant technical experience, ability to perform the required scope and a comparable level of effort, knowledge and experience with comparable system-of-systems integration efforts, ability to meet the required performance schedule and any other information demonstrating the respondent's capability to satisfy the Government's requirements without unacceptable disruption to mission support. Responses shall be submitted to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist no later than 10AM PDT on 23 September 2026. Responses submitted in response to this notice are for the Government's consideration in determining whether a competitive acquisition is appropriate. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract action based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Submission of information in response to this notice is voluntary. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting a response. This notice does not constitute a solicitation, and the Government is not obligated to award a contract as a result of this notice.

title: U012--VA Acquisition Academy (VAAA) Federal Acquisition Certification – Core-Plus Digital Services (FAC-C-DS) - Digital IT Acquisition Program (DITAP)
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) intends to solicit a single-award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) with the authorized vendors identified by the Federal Acquisition Institute (FAI): https://www.fai.gov/certification/fac-c/contracting-fac/fac-c-digital-services https://techfarhub.usds.gov/get-started/ditap/ This service will support the Veterans Affairs Acquisition Academy (VAAA) in obtaining training for the Federal Acquisition Certification Core-Plus Digital Services (FAC-C-DS), Digital IT Acquisition Program (DITAP). Scope: The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, transportation, and other incidentals necessary to develop and provide instructor-guided education in the area of FAC-C-Digital Services, Digital IT Acquisition Program (DITAP), as described, focused on enhancing the skills and understanding of a diverse acquisition workforce. The training program curriculum shall be validated by OFPP and the U.S. Digital Service. This proposed BPA is for services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with the authorized vendors FAI has identified. This is a "Notice of Intent" and not a request for competitive quotes. Interested parties that feel they can provide the services may respond to the point of contact listed in this notice no later than 1:00 PM ET on September 23, 2026.

title: Corrective and Preventative Maintenance of Electronic Security Systems at the Ronald Reagan Building
description: RFQ Amendment 0002 has been posted below. Furthermore, industry questions and answers are forthcoming based on the questions received from industry. RFQ Amendment 0001 has been posted below. NOTE: PLEASE BE ADVISED BEGINNING MONDAY, AUGUST 17, 2026 TRAVEL RESTIRICTIONS BEGIN AROUND THE RONALD REGAN BUILDING DUE TO THE PREPARATION FOR THE GRAND PRIX RACE. PLEASE ACCOUNT FOR POTENTIAL TRAVEL DELAY AND ALLOW ADDITONAL TRAVEL TIME TO ATTEND THE SITE VISIT SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, AUGUST 17, 2026 AT 10AM ET. The US Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Federal Protective Service (FPS) has a requirement for corrective and preventative maintenance of electronic security systems and the replacement and removal of outdated electronic security systems at the Ronald Reagan Building (DC0459). The Contractor shall provide preventive maintenance, repair, replacement, lifecycle upgrades and installations to meet assessed security vulnerabilities / gaps in existing security systems. The services include, but are not limited to, routine and preventive maintenance, repairs and service calls. The VSS equipment includes, interior and exterior fixed IP cameras, controllers, monitors and NVR recorders, power supplies, and all associated ancillary equipment and infrastructure that are part of the Ronald Reagan Building Complex. The Period of Performance is for a one-year base ordering period with four one-year optional ordering periods. An Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with fixed priced provisions is anticipated. This acquisition is being solicited as a total Women-Owned Small Business set aside. Resultant task orders under this contract will be firm fixed price. The source selection process to be utilized for this acquisition is best value/trade-off. The technical, non-price factor, when combined, is more important than price. The submission requirements and evaluation criteria will be defined in the solicitation. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 561621 with size standard is $25 million. The successful Contractor is required to be register with the System for Award Management (SAM) at http://www.sam.gov to be eligible for award. All questions must be submitted in writing to Contract Specialist Christopher Kelly at Christopher.Kelly@fps.dhs.gov.

title: Remote DVD Kits
description: The mission of Air Force Libraries is outlined in DoDI 1015.10 stating DoD Libraries will provide information resources and services required to accomplish the mission. DAF Libraries needs DVD kits for remote and isolated locations. The purpose is to procure two boxed kit plans providing DVD/Blu-Ray kits. This will be at least 1 boxed kit each for locations monthly. Each box kit will contain newly released DVD/Blu-Rays, all locations receiving the same DVD/Blu-Rays each month. DAF Libraries is looking for an established seller of DVD/Blu-Rays in the commercial marketplace.

title: Office Furniture - SFS Command
description: Description - The 375th Contracting Squadron is at Scott AFB, IL is contemplating an award for the procurement, delivery and installation of commercial office furniture for the 375th Security Forces Squadron (SFS) Command Section. This project's scope includes providing all necessary labor, equipment, and materials to facilitate the removal and proper disposal of all current furniture from multiple rooms. Award Procedures - The Government will award a contract to the responsible offeror whose offer is most advantageous, with price and other factors considered. The evaluation process will be based on the lowest-priced, technically acceptable offer. The Government will first evaluate the two lowest-priced offers. If both are technically acceptable, the award will be made to the lowest-priced offeror. If one is found to be technically unacceptable, the next lowest offer will be evaluated, and this process will continue until two technically acceptable offers are identified. The award will then be made to the lowest-priced of these two. Technical data required to respond will not be furnished as part of the presolicitation. Technical data requirements will be in the RFQ. If a vendor wants to be considered for the solicitation, vendor must contact the designated Points of Contact (POCs) and request the official RFQ. The POCs will distribute the RFQ directly to interested vendors. Responsible Sources - All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. If a vendor wants to be considered for the solicitation, vendor must contact the designated POCs and request the official RFQ. The POCs will distribute the RFQ directly to interested vendors. 9-14-2026: Amendment 01 posted. Two files added.

title: FY27 (BASE+4) Renal Pathology Biopsy Services
description: Special Notice of Intent to Sole Source This is a SPECIAL NOTICE ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. The Department of Veteran Affairs, VISN 2 Network Contracting Office intends to award a sole source contract for the Northport VAMC, New York. This proposed contract action is for a service in which the Government intends to award a firm fixed-price comprehensive renal pathology biopsy service contract with only one source; Nephrology Associates, PLC dba Arkana Laboratories, 10810 Executive Center Drive, Suite 100, Little Rock, AK 72211 under the authority Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 6.302-1 Only One Responsible Source. Places of Performance: Department of Veterans Affairs Northport VAMC Laboratory Department 79 Middleville Road Northport, NY 11768 Purpose and Objectives: The intent of this Special Notice is to identify potential offerors capable of providing comprehensive renal pathology biopsy service for the Laboratory Department at Northport VAMC, New York. General Requirements The contractor shall provide comprehensive renal biopsy pathology and nephropathology reference laboratory services for the evaluation of native and transplant kidney biopsy specimens. Response: Responses to this Special Notice should be able to demonstrate the firm's ability, capability, and responsibility to deliver the service listed above. The purpose of this Special Notice announcement is for market research to make appropriate acquisition decisions and to gain knowledge of potential qualified Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses, Veteran Owned Small Businesses, 8(a), HubZone and other Small Businesses interested and capable of providing the services described above. Documentation of technical expertise must be presented in sufficient detail for the Government to determine that your company possesses the necessary functional area expertise and experience to compete for this acquisition. No funds have been authorized, appropriated, or received for this effort. Responses should include the following information: Business name, address, business size and Socioeconomic Category (HUBZone, 8(a), Service Disabled Veteran, Small Business, Large Business, etc.), and point of contact to include e-mail address and telephone number. All offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (www.sam.gov) and Representations and Certifications must be completed prior to any future award. Supporting evidence must be furnished in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to provide the full maintenance and repair service on equipment listed. Special Notice Determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Important information: The Government is not obligated to, nor will it pay for or reimburse any costs associated with responding to this sources sought synopsis request. This notice shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or ultimately award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. The Government will in no way be bound to this information if any solicitation is issued. No subcontracting opportunity is anticipated. The North American Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 621511 ($41.5 Million). Any offeror capable of providing this service shall notify the Contracting Officer by email within 14 calendar days from the date of the publication of this Special Notice. All information is to be submitted via e-mail to: Michelle.Harsch@va.gov

title: FEMA Region VI: IT Equipment
description: The Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, has identified a need to replace end-of-life laptops and acquire various IT peripheral equipment necessary to maintain operational capability, cybersecurity compliance, and workforce productivity. The purpose of this Request for Quotation is to solicit quotations from authorized resellers and distributors for the supply of the brand-name equipment identified in the schedule of supplies, including Dell, Cisco, Samsung, Sharp, Crestron, and associated peripheral equipment. This RFQ is issued as an open market total small business set-aside under NAICS 541519, Other Computer Related Services, with a small business size standard of $34.0 million. Award will be made to the lowest-priced, technically acceptable responsible small business quoter whose quotation conforms to all requirements of this RFQ. The Product Service Code for this requirement is 7B22, IT and Telecom, Compute: Servers, Storage, and Components. Offerors shall identify the exact brand name, model number, part number, and specifications of each item proposed. All quoted items must match the specified brand name, model number, part number, and configuration exactly. Substitutions, alternatives, or deviations will not be accepted unless expressly authorized in writing by the Contracting Officer. Offerors must be authorized resellers or distributors of the specified brands. The Government reserves the right to verify reseller or distributor authorization directly with the original equipment manufacturer. Offerors shall provide a letter or certificate of authorization upon request. The Government seeks quotes with a total price less than $327,000.00. Quoters should not interpret this figure as a ceiling or as a floor on offers. This information is provided as a courtesy to prospective offerors. The Government may select an offer for award with a price below, at, or exceeding this figure if it finds the quotation technically acceptable, price is reasonable, and funds are available. Delivery shall be FOB Destination. Equipment shall be delivered within 70 calendar days after receipt of order. Shipment tracking information and delivery confirmation shall be provided upon request. All questions and quotations shall be submitted by email to the Contracting Officer, Destiny Dyson, at Destiny.Dyson@fema.dhs.gov. Phone calls will not be accepted. Quoters shall use the following identifier on all correspondence: Open Market RFQ 70FBR626Q00000043 - FEMA Region VI IT Equipment Questions regarding this RFQ are due no later than September 17, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Central Time. Questions shall be submitted by email to the Contracting Officer, Destiny Dyson, at Destiny.Dyson@fema.dhs.gov. Questions submitted after the deadline may not be answered. Oral questions or responses are not binding. Only written responses issued by the Contracting Officer are binding on the Government. Quotations are due no later than September 23, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Central Time. Quotations shall be submitted by email to the Contracting Officer, Destiny Dyson, at Destiny.Dyson@fema.dhs.gov. Quotations submitted by any other method may not be considered unless expressly authorized by the Contracting Officer. Quoters are responsible for ensuring that quotations are received by the Contracting Officer by the due date and time. Late quotations may not be considered in accordance with applicable procedures. Quotations shall remain valid for 30 calendar days from the quotation due date. Delivery Address: FEMA Region VI Federal Regional Center 800 North Loop 288 Denton, Texas 76209

title: BEAMERS Industry Day Announcement
description: INDUSTRY DAY: DARPA will host an Industry Day in support of Beam-Space Analog Processing for Multifunctional Enhanced RF Systems (BEAMERS) program on September 30, 2026, located at the Strategic Analysis, Inc. Executive Conference Center (ECC), 4075 Wilson Blvd, Suite 300, Arlington, VA 22203 from 8:00am to 5:00pm ET. This event will be conducted in two parts: a government presentation portion at the SECRET level, which will comprise most of the event, and an Industry Showcase Poster Session portion at the Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) level. Both portions exclusively require advanced registration. The purpose of this event is to provide information on the BEAMERS program; promote additional discussion on this topic; address questions; and provide a forum for interested organizations to present their capabilities for teaming opportunities. PROGRAM OBJECTIVE AND DESCRIPTION: DARPA�s Strategic Technology Office invites interested organizations to attend an industry engagement for BEAMERS, an ambitious new program focused on wideband, staring electronic-support systems. Electronic support cuts across many operational needs, platforms, and environments. Warning, situational awareness, sensing, and related missions impose different requirements for coverage, sensitivity, latency, dynamic range, size, weight, power, and processing. Staring architectures make a large amount of information available continuously. A successful system cannot assume that every beam, frequency channel, and polarization output will be digitized, transported, and processed at full fidelity. BEAMERS emphasizes architectures that maintain persistent awareness, organize and reduce the available analog information, recognize signals of potential interest, and route selected observations to digitization. Required expertise includes analog beamspace processing using lenses, gradient-index structures, phased-array-fed lenses, and related spatial-transform technologies; integrated radio frequency (RF) and microwave photonics; wideband channelization; event detection and information reduction; switching; and data movement. Organizations interested in performing as Prime and nontraditional technology providers are encouraged to attend, identify complementary capabilities, and consider teaming arrangements.
